# openprovider_dns_zones (Data Source)

Lists every DNS zone of the account, so a configuration can find a zone or react to the zones that exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openprovider_dns_zones" "all" {}

output "zone_names" {
  value = [for zone in data.openprovider_dns_zones.all.zones : zone.zone_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `all`.
- `zones` (Attributes List) The zones of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `creation_date` (String) The date and time when the zone was created.
- `extension` (String) The extension of the zone (`com` in `example.com`).
- `modification_date` (String) The date and time when the zone was last modified.
- `name` (String) The name part of the zone (`example` in `example.com`).
- `provider_name` (String) The DNS provider that hosts the zone.
- `type` (String) The type of the zone (e.g., `master`).
- `zone_name` (String) The full name of the zone (e.g., example.com).
